source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CASHCARD WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_ID
,[CSH_UUID]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_INS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_BRN_ID
,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER]
,[CSH_ISSUE_DATE]
,[CSH_EXPIRY_DATE]
,[CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME]
,[CSH_CREATION_DATE]
,convert(numeric(20,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CSH_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_STS_ID
,[CSH_STATUS_DATE]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CSH_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CSH_CREATED_TS
,[CSH_UPDATED_BY]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CSH_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as  CSH_UPDATED_TS
,[CSH_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PRS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PRS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_EMB_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_EMB_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CTS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CTS_ID
,[CSH_KIT_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_LINKED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_LINKED
,[CSH_BCR_ID]
,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER_ENC]
,[CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_CCL_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_CCL_ID
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID
,[CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_LIFE_CYCLE],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_LIFE_CYCLE
,[CSH_PIN_OFFSET]
,[CSH_PIN_OFFSET_TS]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_CORPORATE],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_CORPORATE
,[CSH_CORPORATE_CIF]
,[CSH_CORPORATE_NAME]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,[CSH_EMBOSSING_NAME]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_IS_PRIMARY],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_IS_PRIMARY
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CSH_PIN_GENERATED],' ',''),''),0)) as CSH_PIN_GENERATED
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CASHCARD_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CASHCARD] STG ON convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CSH_ID
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CUSTOMER WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CUST_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_ID
,STG.[CUST_NUMBER]
,[CUST_TITLE]
,[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
,[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
,[CUST_LAST_NAME]
,[CUST_CCNY_ID]
,[CUST_GENDER]
,convert(date,[CUST_DOB]) as CUST_DOB
,[CUST_EMAIL_ADDRESS]
,[CUST_STATUS]
,[CUST_WORK_PHONE]
,[CUST_MOBILE_PHONE]
,[CUST_DEVICE_ID]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_CCAT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_CCAT_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID
,[CUST_CUSTOM_DATA]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,[CUST_LIMIT_CONFIG]
,[CUST_HOME_PHONE]
,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_1]
,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1]
,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_2]
,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2]
,[CUST_CUIT_CODE_3]
,[CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_ISS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_ISS_ID
,[CUST_RESIDENCE_IND]
,[CUST_BACKGROUND_IND]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CUSTOMER_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CUSTOMER] STG ON convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CUST_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CUST_ID
 AND STG.[CUST_NUMBER] = DELTA.[CUST_NUMBER]
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CLIENT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_ID
,STG.[CLT_UUID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_INS_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_BRN_ID
,STG.[CLT_CIF_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_PARENT_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_PARENT_CLT_ID
,[CLT_TITLE]
,[CLT_FIRST_NAME]
,[CLT_LAST_NAME]
,[CLT_GENDER]
,[CLT_DOB]
,[CLT_EMBOSSING_NAME]
,[CLT_MOBILE_NUMBER]
,[CLT_OTHER_NUMBER]
,[CLT_EMAIL_ADDRESS]
,[CLT_MARITAL_STATUS]
,[CLT_MOTHER_MAIDEN_NAME]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_DOC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_DOC_ID
,[CLT_ID_PROOF]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CLT_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_STS_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CLT_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CLT_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CLT_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CLT_UPDATED_TS
,[CLT_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_CCL_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_CCL_ID
,[CLT_NATIONALITY]
,[CLT_ID_PROOF_DOC]
,[CLT_MIDDLE_NAME]
,[CLT_WORK_PHONE_NO]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_KEY_ROTATION_NO],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_KEY_ROTATION_NO
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CLT_CAF_UPDATE],' ',''),''),0)) as CLT_CAF_UPDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [busc].[ATM_CLIENT_delta] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CLIENT] STG ON DELTA.CLT_ID = convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0))  AND DELTA.CLT_CIF_NUMBER = STG.CLT_CIF_NUMBER 
WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCMAPPING WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAM_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_ID
,STG.[CAM_UUID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_CLT_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_CAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_CAC_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_CSH_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_CSH_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAM_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_STS_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CAM_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as [CAM_CREATED_TS]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CAM_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as [CAM_UPDATED_TS]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_AUDIT_LOG],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_AUDIT_LOG
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAM_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAM_INS_ID

,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm

 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCMAPPING] STG ON DELTA.CAM_ID = convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAM_ID],' ',''),''),0))  
 --AND DELTA.CAM_UUID = STG.[CAM_UUID]
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CARDACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAT_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAT_CRD_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAT_ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAT_ACN_ID
,[CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE]
,[CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff( CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as  CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,[FileName]
,[TABLE_NAME]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm

 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CARDACCOUNT] STG ON convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAT_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CAT_CRD_ID
 AND convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAT_ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CAT_ACN_ID
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_ACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_ATP_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_ATP_ID
,[ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER]
,[ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED]
,[ACN_APD_ID]
,STG.[ACN_STATUS]
,convert(date,[ACN_STATUS_DATE]) as ACN_STATUS_DATE

,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_CUR_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_CUR_ID

,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_BALANCE_1],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_BALANCE_1
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_AMT_CODE_2],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_AMT_CODE_2
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_BALANCE_2],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_BALANCE_2

,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_BALANCE_3],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_BALANCE_3

,convert(date,[ACN_TEMP_CREDIT_LIMIT_DATE]) as ACN_TEMP_CREDIT_LIMIT_DATE
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_GUARANTEE_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_GUARANTEE_AMOUNT
,[ACN_GUARANTEE_TYPE]
,convert(date,[ACN_GUARANTEE_EXPIRY_DATE]) as ACN_GUARANTEE_EXPIRY_DATE
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR

,[ACN_SPECIFIC_DATA]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_PART_NO],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_PART_NO
,[ACN_CUSTOM_DATA]
,[ACN_STATUS_2]
,convert(date,[ACN_STATUS_2_DATE]) as ACN_STATUS_2_DATE
,[ACN_LAST_SOURCE]
,[ACN_LAST_TERMINAL_ID]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_FEP_HOST_SUM],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_FEP_HOST_SUM
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_HOST_FEP_SUM],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_HOST_FEP_SUM
,[ACN_PAN]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_LAST_BATCH_SESSION],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_LAST_BATCH_SESSION
,[ACN_FUNCTIONS]
,[ACN_OVERRIDE_PERMISSION]
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_ISS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_ISS_ID
,[ACN_LIMIT_CONFIG]
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(ACN_LAST_UPDATE_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as ACN_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACN_PAN_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ACN_PAN_EKY_ID
,[FileName]
,[TABLE_NAME]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm

 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_ACCOUNT] STG ON convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.ACN_ID
